title: Endianness is a Gulliver's Travels joke that stuck
body: In 1980 Danny Cohen borrowed big-endian and little-endian from Swift's satire of egg-cracking factions to name the two byte orders for multi-byte numbers. Network protocols standardised on big-endian while most desktops store little-endian, so the joke became a permanent translation duty at every socket boundary.
source_hint: Cohen, 'On Holy Wars and a Plea for Peace', 1980
